outlet: Lincoln County Record-Times (odessarecord.com; the Odessa Record and Davenport Times combined)
title: "Albertson appointed prosecuting attorney" (Olivia Harnack, last updated Dec 24, 2024)
notes: Full text public. Commissioners appointed Ty Albertson, 41, chief deputy prosecutor, on Dec. 16, 2024, effective Jan. 13, 2025, after Adam Walser's election to Superior Court; Kennewick native, in Lincoln County since 2014, lives in Odessa; handled all felony cases; nominated after meeting the Lincoln County Republican Central Committee.
